hook: A Western Ghats frog just turned up in *Nallamala*
hook_b: A Western Ghats frog just turned up in *Nallamala*
tldr: ZSI researchers confirmed three frogs from Saleswaram waterfall in Amrabad Tiger Reserve as Hylarana indica, the first Eastern Ghats record of the species.

beats.what: Three specimens collected at Saleswaram waterfall, Amrabad Tiger Reserve, were identified as the Indian golden-backed frog.
beats.why: Genetic tests showed only 0.2-0.5% divergence from Western Ghats populations, confirming the species.
beats.care: The less-studied Eastern Ghats, including Telangana's Nallamala, may hold more species than recorded.
